# CLI and UI coverage

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-cli-ui-coverage.ts (`npm run gen:docs`).
     Do not edit this file: `test/docs/doc-system.test.ts` regenerates it and
     fails on any difference. -->

my_context has 43 CLI commands and 45 registered UI read routes. 15 of the commands have a route that reads the same data; 28 have none at all, and 25 routes answer a question no command asks.

**The UI is read-only, so this table is about READING.** Every route below reads;
none of them changes anything, and `test/ui/no-writes.test.ts` holds the server's
import graph to that. Where a command CHANGES the corpus — every `add`, `edit`,
`review`, `import` and `refresh` among them — that half of the command is CLI-only
whatever the verdict column says beside it, and the browser composes the command for
you to run rather than running it.

**How "reads the same data" was decided.** A route covers a command when the
route's own path names it — `/api/decay` covers `decay`, `/api/sessions` covers
`session`. Five pairs whose names disagree are declared in
`src/core/cli-ui-coverage.ts` with a sentence each, and the same test holds those
declarations to a command and a route that both still exist.

## Every CLI command

| command | what it does | UI route | what the UI offers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mycontext ack` | record that a person has ruled on a doctor finding, anchored to the item as it stands | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext add` | create an item (--body\|--file --note --observation --step --summary\|--summary-omitted --scope --tags --severity --always --valid-from --original-id --extra --yes) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext audit` | the run-time log of mutations and hook actions | `GET /api/ask/audit` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext carry` | mark one item for delivery at the next injection, then forget it (one-shot, not pin) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext config` | delete/disable a category, or set/unset one field, in config.json | `GET /api/config`<br>`POST /api/config/check`<br>`POST /api/config/preview` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext decay` | items that have not been injected lately | `GET /api/decay` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext doctor` | self-check: index freshness, orphans, drift, dead globs, permissions, session ids | `GET /api/doctor` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext edit` | change an item, with a gate that scales to what the change can do | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext examples` | an example item, and what may be changed on one (--short: the item alone) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext export` | write this corpus to a path outside the workspace, whole or as a pack | `GET /api/port` | the Export screen describes what an export would carry and composes the command; it never writes the artefact |
| `mycontext focus` | narrow what gets injected (--scope --category --preview --relations) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext harden` | make a normative item binding (edit --severity=hard) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext help` | guidance: categories, scope, capture, workflow, cli, tools, slash | `GET /api/help/:topic` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext inbox-promote` | a todo or note becomes a real item, linked back | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext ingest` | emit an extraction request for a document (you are the extractor) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext ingest-apply` | apply extracted candidates as drafts | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext ingest-status` | list ingest sessions and their progress | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext init` | create .my_context here (--pack: found it from an artefact, as drafts) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext lesson` | record a lesson and request candidate rules | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext lesson-accept` | approve a staged rule and create it | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext lesson-discard` | permanently reject a staged rule | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext lesson-stage` | stage derived rule candidates for approval | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext link` | record a relation from one item to another — see mycontext edit --unlink to remove one | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext list` | list items | `GET /api/items` | the Work screen's item list is the same read |
| `mycontext pack` | import an artefact somebody else wrote, and list the packs already imported | `GET /api/packs` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext pin` | inject an item at every session start (edit --always=true) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext procedure` | the one-shot lifecycle: what is ready, what is running, what is finished | `GET /api/procedures`<br>`GET /api/procedure/:id` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext query` | read-only SQL over the index (capped at 1000 rows) | `GET /api/ask/corpus` | Ask reads the same index through a fixed set of filters — it accepts no SQL, so an arbitrary SELECT has no UI equivalent |
| `mycontext ready` | open tasks whose needs are all done, highest priority first | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext rebuild` | rebuild the index from Markdown | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext refresh` | re-snapshot a reference from its source file, through the same gate | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext repair` | re-stamp project items whose recorded checksum no longer matches their content | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext review` | walk the draft and revision queues and settle what should govern | `GET /api/review-queue`<br>`GET /api/revisions` | the queue is browsable; promoting, rejecting and editing a draft stay CLI-only |
| `mycontext search` | find items by text, type, tag, path, relation, or what links to another item | `GET /api/search` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext session` | the sessions this workspace has had, their names, and what is left to carry | `GET /api/sessions`<br>`GET /api/session/:session/injected` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext show` | print an item | `GET /api/item/:id` | an item opens in the browser with the same body and the same governing set |
| `mycontext soften` | make a normative item advisory (edit --severity=soft) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext status` | counts, review queue, ingest progress, decay and health | `GET /api/status` | a route reads the same data |
| `mycontext statusline` | the opt-in status line bridge: tee Claude Code’s context figure for the web UI | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext supersede` | retire an item in favour of a replacement, both directions recorded | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext todo` | the inbox: what you jotted down, and what it is not | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext ui` | read-only web UI on 127.0.0.1 — preview, coverage, reports | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
| `mycontext unpin` | stop injecting an item at every session start (edit --always=false) | — | no UI route reads this — CLI only |
